records.name: Gus Meter
records.biography_en: Gus Meter serves with the Survey Detail of The Cooling Detail. The kit includes a small analog survey meter with blank dial ticks. Hypernormalization assignments send the crew where a dangerous card or an incident has unsettled a district.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Gus Meter treats the equipment check as the first useful part of every briefing.
